name: Berkeley County, WV
findings: Berkeley County has 288 nonprofit organizations. 116 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 92 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Berkeley County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Berkeley County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 94 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 28 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Berkeley County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
